bullets.bullet_text: Led quantitative derivatives, variable-annuity hedging, and insurance-capital work by architecting exotic pricing models, liability Greeks, and higher-order stress-testing frameworks for regulated financial institutions.

Directed CCAR-era capital, liquidity, and stress-testing engagements, structuring traceable scenario suites, challenger model variants, and model-risk remediation programs that produced audit-ready governance evidence.

Architected enterprise risk management operating models aligned to BCBS 239, defining three-lines-of-defense accountability, metadata standards, and auditable risk metrics for regulatory data aggregation.
